title: Planeswalker Animated Series Coming to Netflix in 2027
excerpt: Magic: The Gathering is finally getting its long-awaited Netflix animated series, titled Planeswalker, scheduled for release in 2027.
body_html:
An animated series based on Magic: The Gathering is officially heading to Netflix. Titled Planeswalker, the project is scheduled for release in 2027.

Roy Graham, Head of Story at Magic: The Gathering, announced the upcoming series in a video released recently, offering reassurance that the project is moving forward after previous development efforts.

An animated series adaptation for the franchise was initially teased in 2019 with involvement from filmmakers Joe and Anthony Russo, though the project faced changes before this latest announcement.
